description: Catalog of themes available in the openpresentation.org catalog. Each entry is a lightweight summary; full theme records live in the per-id JSON files alongside this index.

records.name: Minimal
records.description: A clean, minimalistic theme with a focus on simplicity and readability. Ideal for professional, straightforward presentations.

records.name: Classic
records.description: A timeless, clean, and versatile theme with balanced color contrasts and classic typography. Ideal for professional, readable presentations.

records.name: Bold
records.description: A vibrant, high-energy theme with bold colors and a dynamic, attention-grabbing style. Great for presentations that need to stand out.

records.name: Duotone
records.description: Two colors that ink each other, claret on pale ice and ice on claret, with a sturdy slab serif for headings over a plain humanist sans. For workshops, programs and pitches that want a confident, recognizable look without a photograph.
